summary: Iteration 6: I tested HTML-fragment cleanup, the alarm sound toggle, the Glitch-Alarm banner, fonts and regressions. Backend: 60/60 pytest pass after one fix (new test_html_sanitize.py: 7 endpoints plus _to_text unit tests). Across all 2009 glitch documents in the database, none has '<' or an HTML entity in its title or description. The UI showed no HTML leftovers on 24 radar cards, 10 Lieferdienste cards or 3 detail pages. terminal-alarm-sound-switch is ON by default, toggling saves alarmSound to gr_settings_v1, and the value survives a reload. The glitch-alarm banner showed with a seeded price_error (seed removed afterwards), with no expo-audio console errors on web. Fonts BarlowCondensed, Satoshi and JetBrainsMono loaded and in use, no serif fallback. Search ('amazon', 62 results), the Lieferdienste chip, /favorites and /pro all work. Regression found and fixed: min_discount was ignored for type=all and type=delivery. No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) found.

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent: the Lieferdienste commit (9926019) changed `if type != 'all'` to `elif` and removed the `if min_discount > 0:` line. Since then the discount filter only applied inside the specific-type branch, so the Terminal 'Mindest-Rabatt im Radar' setting (50/70/80 %) was ignored on the 'Alle' and 'Lieferdienste' tabs. The existing test test_list_glitches_min_discount was failing because of this.

The title is not passed through _to_text, only .strip(). An RSS title with escaped HTML (e.g. '&amp;') would be stored as '&' until the next backend restart, when the startup cleanup fixes it. Suggest title = _to_text(title).

issues: terminal-alarm-sound-switch is only 40x20 px on web, below the 44pt touch target, and the row itself is not pressable. Consider making the whole row toggle it.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AppSplash.tsx:52

action_items: Review the restored min_discount filter in server.py list_glitches. It now applies to all types, including 'all' and 'delivery'.
In feeds._parse_item, run the title through _to_text so newly polled items are clean without waiting for a restart.
Remove the duplicated HTML cleanup loop in server.py startup (lines ~762-776: two nearly identical loops).
AppSplash: move pointerEvents='none' into style to silence the deprecation warning.
Optional: make the Alarm-Ton row pressable to enlarge the touch target.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup has two copy-pasted cleanup loops (DRY). The second regex '[<>]' also matches legitimate '>' text every startup (harmless but wasteful).
feeds._to_text truncation: description[:600] is cut after cleaning, which can end mid-word without ' …'. Minor.
GlitchAlarm: on the first app load every currently active alarm id counts as 'fresh' and triggers the ping, which is expected. Seen ids are capped at 200.
server.py is 785 lines (over 700). Consider splitting the routers.
seed_data_creation: Temporary price_error glitch with source_url https://www.mydealz.de/TEST_alarm_ui_iter6, inserted via seed_alarm_ui.py and deleted after the UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use `python /app/backend/tests/seed_alarm_ui.py seed|clean` to force a Glitch-Alarm banner. pytest.ini uses xdist (-n), so do not pass -p no:xdist. Audio playback itself was not verified (blocked by browser autoplay); only the absence of errors was checked.
rca_of_issue: min_discount regression: git log -L showed commit 9926019 turned `if type != 'all'` into `elif` and deleted the separate `if min_discount > 0:` line, which moved the discount filter into the type branch.
